visual_review.observations: A wide, high-angle view of two parallel bowling lanes with light wood grain surfaces, dark side gutters, and a central divider. Two ball return trays hold white pins with red stripes, while the far end shows dark scoring consoles and overhead structures.

A top-down perspective emphasizes symmetrical lane geometry, with a prominent central mechanical track running between the lanes. Pin clusters appear near the upper lane area, and dark rectangular panels are aligned along the top edge, creating a structured, grid-like arrangement.

A close-up shows glossy white bowling pins with red double stripes arranged in a triangular rack on a wooden surface. Behind them, colorful balls in blue, red, and green are visible in a dark return area, with a black tray edge in the foreground.
